_about: Values used to work out prices and payments. Money is in pence.

price._formula: worked-out price = (ingredient cost + prep cost + per tray slot x tray slots) x (1 + margin) x (1 + markup) x house price level x staleness factor. A dish's price.fixed, if set, replaces the worked-out part (house level and staleness still apply).
price._markup: Fraction added to every worked-out price.
price._margin: Fraction added on top of cost.
price._prepPerMinute: Pence per minute of cooking, tended or untended. Split across the servings of a batch.
price._perTraySlot: Pence added to each serving per tray slot it takes.
price._roundShownTo: Shown prices are rounded to this many pence; the exact amount is paid.

_deliveryFee: Pence the carter charges each morning he brings orders, however many.
